quote: an integer n > 1 such that n² divides 2^(n-1)-1 must be a Wieferich prime
note: Conjectured by Thomas Ordowski on December 21, 2016 as a comment on OEIS sequence A001220. The conjecture states that no composite numbers satisfy the Wieferich-like condition 2^c ≡ 1 (mod c²). While the general theory of Wieferich primes and pseudoprimes dates to earlier work, this specific question appears to be first posed by Ordowski in 2016.
